lead: The “City of Parks” northeast of Sioux Falls, home to Devil's Gulch and next to Palisades State Park.
living:
Garretson is a small city in Minnehaha County, northeast of Sioux Falls near the Minnesota line, with 1,228 people at the 2020 Census. It calls itself the "City of Parks," and the red Sioux quartzite along Split Rock Creek is the reason why.

Devil's Gulch, where legend says Jesse James jumped the canyon, and Split Rock Park are on the north end of town. Palisades State Park, known for its quartzite cliffs, is just a few miles away.
know: What to know before you buy in Garretson

• Small-town market: only a few homes are for sale at a time, so it helps to get alerts and move quickly.
  • Acreages nearby: many listings around Garretson are on acreage; check well, septic and road maintenance before you buy.
  • Older downtown: some downtown buildings were built from hand-quarried quartzite from a local quarry that opened in the 1890s.
  • Commute: plan on about 25–30 minutes to central Sioux Falls.
schools: Garretson is served by the Garretson School District. Always confirm the school district for a specific address.

What county is Garretson in?

Garretson is in Minnehaha County. Property taxes are set by Minnehaha County, the city and the local school district.

What school district serves Garretson?

Garretson is served by the Garretson School District. Always confirm the district for a specific address.

How far is Garretson from Sioux Falls?

Garretson is northeast of Sioux Falls near the Minnesota line. Plan on about 25–30 minutes to central Sioux Falls.
